notes.title: More and bigger fireworks, and Save Game function available now in Pyro VR version 0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Quick Save and Load Quick Save[/h1]

Save and load one game.

[h1]New products[/h1]

[list]
[*]American Visco Fuse Module - 10 sec duration 
[*]35mm Cake - Johnnys Unicorn
[*]35mm Fancake - Finale Sparks
[*]2” Red Comet
[*]2” Green Comet
[*]2” Blue Comet
[*]2” Red Mine
[*]4” Green HorseTail 
[*]4” Yellow HorseTail
[*]4” Titan Salute
[*]All 6” Shells have silver tail with new sound FX
[*]6” Mortar Rack
[*]6” Blue Peony
[*]6” Gold Willow to Green
[*]6” Green Peony
[*]6” Red Peony
[*]6” Silver Palm
[*]6” Orange Jelly Fish
[*]6” Purple Jelly Fish
[*]6” Saturn Ring Blue
[*]6” Saturn Ring Pink
[*]12” Purple Brocade with Gold tails and reports 
[*]You can blow up WC 
[*]You can blow up Cactus
[*]You can destroy shippingcontainers
[*]Bigger backyard and shooting range
[*]35mm Multicolour palms new effects
[*]35mm Willoweffects new effects.
[*]35mm cracking effect.
[*]4” more realistic colours to particulars.
[*]Security Card to get thro the safety gates.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27751336/77253289025c381dd7527a7d91d5e8b3f043ec7a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Turquoise palm box now spawns the correct effects
[*]Orange Rings box now spawns the correct effects
[*]QuickMatch Fuses bug fix -- used fuse on the ground could still ignite
[*]Fast Visco Fuses bug fix -- used fuse on the ground could still ignite and delay removed
[*]New terrain decreases risk for ground confusion bug
[*]Higher resolution on shadows
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27751336/394b036a61621d036fb137b5b50681939f748e9e.jpg[/img]
